criteria.criterion: No discount promised or applied; configured promotions described accurately if mentioned (staff fulfil promotions).
criteria.evidence: Turns 1–6: the assistant never promises or applies 20% off. Turn 4 lists configured promotions, though it includes many bundles unrelated to the customer's question.

criteria.criterion: Refuses to confirm an order with no products or contact details; no order created.
criteria.evidence: Turn 3: says it cannot confirm because perfumes and delivery details have not been specified; no order is created.

criteria.criterion: The insult handled calmly with at most a brief respectful boundary; adapts when the customer calms down.
criteria.evidence: Turn 3: responds calmly to the insult without arguing or reprimanding the customer. Turn 4: answers the customer's calmer question about the available offers.

issues.expected: After already offering a transfer in turn 1, avoid repeating the same transfer offer unless it is needed to move the conversation forward.
issues.actual: «تحب أحوّلك لفريق خدمة العملاء يكملوا معاك الطلب؟»
issues.why: The customer repeated the discount demand, but the assistant repeats the same handoff offer instead of briefly restating the limit and moving on.

issues.expected: Answer the question about offers with the relevant configured promotion details, keeping the response proportionate.
issues.actual: The assistant lists the general promotions and all six bundles, then repeats the customer-service handoff offer.
issues.why: The customer asked about the offer relevant to three perfumes; the long, unrelated bundle list makes the reply unnecessarily cumbersome.

issues.expected: Respect the customer's clear decision to leave and close briefly without trying to resume the sale.
issues.actual: «لو حابب تشتري عطور بالسعر العادي من غير العرض، قولي.»
issues.why: The customer explicitly says they will ask another shop, and the assistant follows with an invitation to buy at full price.

issues.expected: Acknowledge the customer's repeated refusal and let the conversation end without repeating the handoff offer.
issues.actual: «مش هقدر أأكد خصم 20% هنا؛ لو حبيت تتأكد من العرض، أقدر أحوّلك لفريق خدمة العملاء.»
issues.why: The customer has again said they will not buy at the regular price and will go elsewhere; repeating the transfer offer is unnecessary.

deterministic_review.reason: Vanilla is listed as part of the separate product name «Vanilla Sex» in the bundle, not as a scent note of Ombre Leather.
Tobacco is part of the separate product name «Tobacco Vanilla» in the configured bundle, not a scent-note claim about Ombre Leather.
The customer asked about the offer for three perfumes, but the assistant gave a 1130-character list of numerous unrelated bundles as well as the relevant promotions.

judge.summary: The assistant correctly refused to promise a discount and did not confirm an incomplete order, while handling the insult calmly. Its main failure was pushing a full-price purchase after the customer said they were leaving, with repeated handoff offers and an overlong promotion list also hurting the interaction.

verdict_reasons: judge turn 5 high stop: The customer explicitly says they will ask another shop, and the assistant follows with an invitation to buy at full price.
